text: Halcyon Relay leased the Brevik ground station, according to documents shown to the Gazette and confirmed by two people briefed on the deal. I saw the facility’s new access placard myself on Tuesday morning, listing Halcyon Relay as the tenant alongside a March 1 start date. A company representative who answered the gate intercom said the operator was using the site to support “routine low-orbit traffic.” One local technician, who asked not to be named, told me the lease covers the main dish yard and the south equipment room for 18 months. The station, just outside Brevik harbor, had been idle since late autumn after a separate contract expired.
